content.text: In Nigeria, Kenya, and across the Global South, [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/digital-product-payment-solutions-west-africa-which-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-architecture-behind-google-apps-script-digital-commerce-19|COREMERCH guide to architecture]]|digital]] [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-creators-ghana-get-paid-online-what-actually-2|How Creators]] face a common barrier: payment processors like Stripe and PayPal are either unavailable or impose crippling restrictions. Your audience wants your ebooks, courses, and templates, but conventional platforms lock you out of the transaction. This guide solves that problem by deploying a sovereign crypto store on Cloudflare Pages—infrastructure you own, not rent. No subscriptions. No platform dependency. Just a stack that processes payments directly to your wallet, delivers products instantly, and scales as you grow.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

Cloudflare Pages provides free, globally distributed hosting with built-in SSL and CDN. Paired with Cloudflare Workers for serverless backend logic and Supabase for order storage, this stack eliminates single points of failure. NOWPayments handles crypto transactions with a 0.5% fee, no KYC, and automatic on-chain verification. Unlike platforms that can suspend your account or withhold funds, this infrastructure is permissionless. You control the keys. Your customers pay directly to your wallet. The system operates independently of any third-party approval, making it ideal for regions where financial services are restricted or unreliable.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Start with a Cloudflare account and a crypto wallet compatible with NOWPayments (MetaMask, Trust Wallet, etc.). Prepare your digital products—ebooks, courses, templates—and ensure they’re compressed for fast delivery. You’ll need basic familiarity with GitHub for version control and a text editor for configuring Workers scripts. If you’re deploying Stack 02, COREMERCH handles the entire setup in 48 hours, including SPF/DKIM/DMARC email configuration and end-to-end testing. For self-deployment, allocate 4-6 hours to follow the Sovereign Blueprint step-by-step.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

First, integrate NOWPayments into your Cloudflare Worker. Configure webhooks to trigger product delivery the moment payment confirms on-chain. Use Supabase to store order details and customer emails. For file delivery, upload products to Cloudflare R2 or Google Drive, generating signed URLs that expire after download. Test the flow locally using the Workers CLI before deploying to Cloudflare Pages. If you opt for the Edge Commerce Stack ($197), COREMERCH pre-configures this pipeline, loads your first five products, and hands over a fully tested system ready for mainnet transactions.
Own the infrastructure, not the platform. No subscriptions. No access revocation.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Deploy your store to Cloudflare Pages with a custom domain or the free .pages.dev subdomain. Point your DNS settings to Cloudflare for global distribution. Test the entire flow—from product selection to crypto payment to file delivery—using testnet tokens. Once confirmed, switch to mainnet and promote your store. Share the link directly or embed it in your existing website. Every transaction bypasses intermediaries, depositing funds directly into your wallet within minutes of on-chain confirmation.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

Monitor transaction volume and customer behavior using Supabase queries and Cloudflare analytics. Add new products by updating your Workers script and reloading files into R2. For higher traffic, upgrade to Cloudflare’s paid Workers plan for increased compute limits. If you outgrow Stack 02, the Complete Builder Kit ($197) includes blueprints for all five COREMERCH stacks, allowing you to migrate to more advanced architectures without downtime. The infrastructure is yours—scale it as your business demands.
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

The COREMERCH Edge Commerce Stack ($197) deploys Stack 02 in 48 hours, using Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Workers for backend logic, Supabase for order storage, and NOWPayments for crypto processing. It includes SPF/DKIM/DMARC email configuration, end-to-end testing, and 30-day support. Stack 01, in contrast, uses GitHub Pages and Google Apps Script, taking 4-6 hours to self-deploy via the Sovereign Blueprint. Choose Stack 02 for enterprise-grade infrastructure or Stack 01 for a faster, lighter setup.
Deploy Stack 02 in 48 hours with COREMERCH or self-deploy Stack 01 in 4-6 hours.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

If you’re deploying Stack 01, visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to see a live example of a GitHub Pages store. For a more robust solution, the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) delivers Stack 02 fully configured and tested in 48 hours. Both stacks use NOWPayments for crypto processing, but Stack 02 adds Cloudflare’s enterprise-grade tools for scalability and security. Explore the Complete Builder Kit for access to all blueprints and templates.
Your Deployment Checklist

1. Create a Cloudflare account and set up a new Pages project. 2. Configure a Cloudflare Worker to handle payment webhooks and file delivery logic. 3. Integrate NOWPayments by adding your API key and selecting preferred cryptocurrencies. 4. Upload products to Cloudflare R2 and generate signed URLs for secure downloads. 5. Test the payment flow using testnet tokens before going live on mainnet. 6. Deploy to Cloudflare Pages and verify global accessibility. 7. Promote your store link and start accepting crypto payments directly to your wallet.
Frequently Asked Questions
Can I use this stack if I’m completely new to coding?

Yes, but expect a learning curve. The Sovereign Blueprint provides step-by-step instructions, and the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) handles deployment for you. Basic familiarity with GitHub and text editors is recommended for self-deployment.
What cryptocurrencies can I accept with NOWPayments?
NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies. For low transaction fees, recommend BSC, Solana, or TRON to your customers—all under $0.10 per transaction.
How do I handle refunds or chargebacks?
Crypto transactions are irreversible, so design your store to clarify this to customers. Use Supabase to log all transactions and customer emails for manual follow-ups if needed.
Can I migrate from Stack 01 to Stack 02 later?
Yes. The Complete Builder Kit includes blueprints for both stacks, allowing you to migrate without downtime. COREMERCH can also handle the migration for a fee.
What happens if Cloudflare or Supabase goes down?

Cloudflare’s global CDN minimizes downtime risk, and Supabase’s open-source nature allows self-hosting if needed. Your payment layer (NOWPayments) operates independently, ensuring transactions continue even if other components fail.
Crypto payments confirm on-chain in minutes—no intermediaries, no delays.
